findings.issue: The doc says a review's per-node cost in expansiveBudget is the number of reviewDimensions entries, or four when the list is empty or `all`. The code does not do this. seedBudget passes reviewDimensionCount(source), which is buildDimensionUniverse(config).length (frontier-admit.cjs:310-313, reduce-state.cjs:1224-1235). That function always starts from the four canonical dimensions and appends each distinct custom name. So the cost is never below four: reviewDimensions ['security'] costs 4 (the doc says 1), and a budget of 7 by the doc's rule is 24 in the code.

fix.old: For review it is the count of the config's `reviewDimensions` entries, and four when the list is empty or `all`.
fix.new: For review it is the size of the reducer's dimension universe (`buildDimensionUniverse`): the canonical four plus each distinct custom name in `reviewDimensions`, so never below four.

findings.issue: The fanout-run.cjs section writes the flag as `--depth-mode=expansive`. fanout-run.cjs parseArgs (fanout-run.cjs:107-124) does not split on `=`. It turns `--depth-mode=expansive` into the key `depthMode=expansive`, which assertKnownFlags rejects as an unknown option with exit 3. The script accepts only `--depth-mode expansive`, which is how deep-research.yaml:393 and deep-review.yaml:386 call it.

The convergence.cjs section says depthMode comes from `--depth-mode` and then writes `--depth-mode=expansive`. convergence.cjs parseArgs (convergence.cjs:150-167) does not split on `=`, so that form fails as an unknown option. The script accepts only `--depth-mode expansive` or `--depth_mode expansive`.

The doc says `--extend-minutes=M ... adds minutes to that run's duration budget`. step_extend_completed_run (deep-review.yaml:543-548, and the matching research step) computes the new budget as max(prior maxDurationMinutes, minutes already elapsed since createdAt) + M. Without --extend-minutes it still adds the prior maxDurationMinutes when the run has a budget. So the minutes are not added to the old budget when the time already spent is larger.
